== Original post ==

'''QUIET MINING COLONY CAN WORK'''
* '''Author:''' mike "Jabba king" maciejewski
* '''Published:''' January 22, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 2.5
* '''Description:''' IT CAN WORK

=== Strategy ===

IN THE FIRST TURN DEPLOY BESPIN CLOUD CITY. ALSO TRY TO DEPLOY AS MANY PEOPLE AND STARSHIPS AS YOU CAN SO YOU CAN FORCE DRAIN WITHOUT USEING FORCE. THEN JUST DO WHAT YOU FEEL IS RIGHT.

I HAVE WON WITH THIS DECK, SO IT ISNT THAT BAD.

OOPS THIS IS A LIGHT SIDE DECK
